contexts.text: To ascend into the high mountain and evangelize () = to worship the Lord from love and charity.
To evangelize upon the mountains () = to preach the Lord from the doctrine of love and charity, and to worship from these.
To evangelize His salvation (). Explained.
An Angel = the Gospel, which is of the Lord alone.

This Gospel of the Kingdom shall be preached in the whole habitated [earth], for a testimony to all nations () = that this shall first be made known in the Christian world... This Gospel of the Kingdom = this truth that thus it is; Gospel = annunciation; Kingdom = truth. AE 741:15.
The Evangelists, mentioned. AE 815:2. DSS 2.
Evangelizing and making to hear peace () = the Lord's Kingdom.
A trumpet and a great voice = evangelization.
That such would receive the Gospel. Signified.
The voice of a trumpet = truth Divine through Heaven in an internal form, and its evangelization.
A representative of the Lord... as to the things which concern evangelization and worship. Signified.
To minister = when in worship and evangelization. Explained.

For by evangelization are meant all things in the Word which treat of the Lord, and all things which in worship represented Him; for evangelization is annunciation concerning the Lord, His Advent, and concerning the things which are from Him, which belong to salvation and eternal life: and as all things of the Word, in its inmost sense, treat of the Lord alone, and also all things of worship represented Him, therefore the whole Word is the Gospel; in like manner all worship which is carried on according to the things commanded in the Word; and as the priests were set over the worship, and also taught, therefore by their ministry was signified worship and evangelization.
Hence His Advent into the world is called the Gospel of the Kingdom. DLord 42:end.
As the Gospel could not... reach all... DP 254:3.

As He hath evangelized to His servants the prophets () = that after the Last Judgment upon those who have devastated the Church, the Lord's Kingdom will come... To evangelize = to announce the Advent of the Lord and to announce His Kingdom; for the Gospel is a glad messenger.
This is meant by the Gospel of the Kingdom, and by the Kingdom of God. Illustrated.
Preface. Evangelization concerning the Advent of the Lord; and then a New Church. Treated of.

I saw another Angel flying in the midst of Heaven, having the everlasting Gospel to evangelize tn them that dwell upon the earth () = the annunciation of the Advent of the Lord, and of the New Church which is to come down out of Heaven from Him. Explained. AR 633.
The Lord speaking and evangelizing from love, that He will now be present with men in His Divine Human. Explained. AR 960.
By the Gospel is signified the Advent of the Lord to His Kingdom.
This does not now appear as the Gospel, but still it is; for the Gospel is to be saved by the Lord.
See Apostle.
The Gospel () that they can be regenerated and thus saved...
In the lower temple is preached the Gospel of the new Advent of the Lord, and also of regeneration and consequent salvation by Him.
That this New Church is meant by... the eternal Gospel which the Angel... evangelized.
Hope of the propagation of this new Gospel...
That the Gospel is preached to Souls...
Paul... before he preached the Gospel...
The Gospel itself is in the Evangelists.
To evangelize = to preach these things... To evangelize good = conjunction with Him through good.
By the evangelizatress Zion () is meant the Church which is in the good of love to the Lord; and by the evangelizatress, Jerusalem, the Church which thence from the Word is in truths of doctrine.
The Angels with the great voice of a trumpet = evangelization concerning the Lord.
To evangelize and the Gospel are often mentioned in the Word, and thereby is signified the Advent of the Lord. Illustrated.
Hence it is that Zion and Jerusalem are called evangelizatresses.... They are so called from the fact that the Gospel = the Advent of the Lord... AE 850:5.
This is the reason why where the Last Judgment is treated of, to evangelize is mentioned. Illustrated.
As to evangelize = to announce the Advent of the Lord, the Gospel, in the supreme sense, = the Lord Himself as to His Advent, as to Judgment, and as to the salvation of the faithful. Illustrated.
Cursed be the man who hath evangelized to his father, saying... () = who acknowledges falsity...
Having the eternal Gospel = concerning His Advent, and concerning the salvation of those who believe in Him.
To evangelize to those that dwell upon the earth = annunciation concerning it to all who are of the Church.
Redemption. 6. 6. This is the Gospel which He commanded should be preached in the whole world.
